notes.subject: ופריץ
notes.rationale: 'Violent one / tyrant' read by most versions as a ravenous beast; the Hebrew word itself names a violent man, not an animal.

notes.subject: בל
notes.rationale: Poetic emphatic negator 'not at all' rendered by Bamanankan katuguni; its creaking failure-sense is lost.

notes.subject: גאולים / פדויי (35:10)
notes.rationale: Redeemed/ransomed pair across verses 9-10 frames the same people two ways; Bamanankan uses two verbs (sɔngɔ / san) and loses the kinship-redeemer root.

translation: Waraba tɛ bɛ yen, ni mɔgɔ minnu bɛ jaw faga, bagan juguw, olu katuguni tɛ se sira in kan, olu tɛ yen sababu la; nka minnu bolo Yawe ye sɔngɔ, olu bɛ taa sira in na.

tokens.gloss: ni mɔgɔ minnu bɛ jaw faga
